title: Analysis code: Infant socioeconomic status moderates preterm birth effects on adult gray matter in females only
description: Analysis code (Python marimo notebooks and R/PROCESS) for Barda et al., Brain Communications (2026). Participant data from the Bavarian Longitudinal Study are confidential and not included; the repository contains synthetic data with the same structure so the full pipeline can be run.
